questions.question: The LORD told Abraham that his wife Sarah would have a son about a year later. True or false?
After eating the meal Abraham served, the three visitors asked where his wife was. What was her name?
After the LORD asked Abraham why Sarah laughed, He asked a second question. What was the point of that second question?

answers.text: Nothing is too difficult for the LORD
Sarah should not listen at the tent
Abraham should have told her sooner
